doc: Emboss (Photoshop style): relief = amount * (luma(p - L*height) - luma(p + L*height)) where L is the unit vector towards the light (angle 0 = light from the right, counter-clockwise on screen) and luma is Rec.709 of the premultiplied colour (transparent = flat), taps are bilinear. mode 'gray': straight colour = 0.5 + relief (flat areas become mid grey); mode 'overlay': straight colour = original + relief. Result clamped to 0..1, alpha unchanged.

angle.doc: light direction, 0 = from the right, counter-clockwise on screen (90 = from above)

height.doc: sample distance on each side of the pixel
